paper.title: A Novel Generative Model with Causality Constraint for Mitigating Biases in Recommender Systems

source.implementation: re-implementation from the paper text; not a reproduction

from_paper: Algorithm 1: iVAE(A, W) and LCVAE(A) in parallel with reparameterized Z and Z_lc, then a recommender on Z_lc
Eq. (6): LCVAE ELBO with N(0, I) prior, Bernoulli decoder and lambda * non-squared L2 ||Z_lc - Z||
lambda = 0.9 Coat, 0.1 Yahoo!R3, 0.9 KuaiRand; Adam; lr/wd inside {1e-3..1e-5} x {1e-5, 1e-6}
MF backbone P_u^T Q_i + B_u + B_i; data split and NDCG@5/Recall@5 following iDCF
local_choices: iVAE, data inputs, proxy W, network sizes, KL anneal, L2 penalty and 80/20 user validation reuse the project iDCF configuration
iVAE keeps its own ELBO in the joint loss; Z is detached inside the constraint
Eq. (18) is read as MF(u, i) + <e_i, Z_lc,u> (iDCF MFMF form) trained with MSE and validation NDCG@5 selection
Stage 1 model selection uses the summed validation loss of both branches after full-beta warm-up
